findings.remediation: The ledger parser now distinguishes exactly one unfinished record only when both migration name and checksum equal the approved target. DATABASE_PRODUCTION_INTENT recovery removes only the fixed outbox table/type, refuses nonempty table data, omits CASCADE, verifies absence, runs fixed-name label-bound Prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back for only the approved name, proves the baseline and retries the fixed migration. Each repair phase is audited.

The in-container bounded health probe now requires HTTP 200, parses the response as JSON, and accepts only exact body status ok; degraded, error, invalid JSON and oversized/failed responses fail activation and enter automatic rollback.
